svg.title: KOTOR decompilation progress
svg.desc: Decompiled with Visual Studio 2022: 9,275 of 9,519 functions (97.4%: 7,573 with their own definition, 1,438 folded into others, 264 C runtime from the VS2022 library), builds the full game. Original Visual Studio .NET 2002 (MSVC 7.0) matching coverage: 6,658 of 9,519 functions (69.9%), 31.0% of code bytes. Source matches: 6,290 (66.1%); original stock LIBCMT.LIB: 368 (3.9%). Each address counts once. Relocation fields are masked during comparison; whole-executable identity is not established.

g.text: Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic — two decompilations of swkotor.exe 1.0.3.0 (GOG)
